question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed `openclaw commands` catalog boundary, and which schema and plugin-metadata fields should become supported compatibility commitments?
rationale: The proposal is technically coherent and proven as a prototype, but the repository lifecycle and the RFC itself reserve namespace, stable schema, plugin metadata, and Gateway convergence for maintainer authority.

options.title: Sponsor narrow Option A
options.body: Create and link the discussion, then accept `openclaw commands list/inspect` after defining the minimum stable contract and its relationship to Gateway `commands.list`.

options.title: Adopt the broader catalog
options.body: Choose the `openclaw catalog` namespace and operational lenses, then revise the RFC and implementation stack around that wider scope.

options.title: Decline a core catalog
options.body: Retain the separate existing registries and close the RFC and linked implementation drafts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow Option A
recommendation.body: Create and link the discussion, then accept `openclaw commands list/inspect` after defining the minimum stable contract and its relationship to Gateway `commands.list`.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the target repository lifecycle requiring this decision record and is the clearest available owner for routing acceptance.
